units.source_text: 我没去浴池，同舞女下起五子棋来。

en.t: I did not go to the bath, but started playing gomoku with the dancing girl.
Unexpectedly, she was a strong player.

units.source_text: 循环赛时，荣吉和其他姑娘轻易地输给我了。

en.t: In the round-robin games, Eikichi and the other girls lost to me easily.

units.source_text: 下五子棋，我实力雄厚，一般人不是我的对手。

en.t: At gomoku, I was very strong, and ordinary players were no match for me.

units.source_text: 我跟她下棋，可以不必手下留情，尽情地下，心情好舒畅啊！

en.t: Playing against her, I did not have to hold back; I could play with all my strength, and it felt wonderfully refreshing.
There were only the two of us in the room.

units.source_text: 起初，她离棋盘很远，要伸长手才能下子。

en.t: At first, she sat far from the board and had to stretch out her arm to place a stone.

units.source_text: 渐渐地，她忘却了自己，一心扑在棋盘上。

en.t: Gradually, she forgot herself and became wholly absorbed in the board.

units.source_text: 她那显得有些不自然的秀美的黑发几乎触到我的胸脯。

en.t: Her beautiful black hair, which seemed somehow a little unnatural, nearly touched my chest.
